title: Gemma 4 E4B via Ollama (default tag)
slug_note: The one-command way to run Gemma 4's edge model on a laptop or small GPU.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's default `gemma4:e4b` tag, 4-bit class; the tag page lists 6.6GB - 9.5GB and does not name the exact quant
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama ps` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-25)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 13.0 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (Ollama 0.40.10 with its own default context on the 128 GB Spark (131,072 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Estimate from the tag size (6.6GB - 9.5GB) plus KV headroom at Ollama's default context. Not measured.

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; Ollama 0.40.10 with its own default context on the 128 GB Spark (131,072 tokens)

caveats: Ollama's default context is small; raise num_ctx for long documents or coding agents.
The model card lists audio input, but Ollama's tag page lists text and image input only.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): `ollama run gemma4:e4b` answered after 13.3 s from a cold start (model files read from disk); 13.0 GiB resident. Ollama 0.40.10 on the 128 GB Spark picked a 131,072-token default context by itself, so memory is weights plus that KV. Set num_ctx lower to save memory.
